_note: secretary tier (K) — `claude --mcp-config` shape. The K-owned kstore working store (work-items, lessons) is mounted so K can track tickets/memory; status-write self-gates to workflow runs. The logistics-mcp (calendar/notes/scheduling) is mounted so K can keep run-scoped notes, calendar events, and reminders (STORAGE, not execution — it does not act on any real calendar). The same portable gitnexus stdio server the chief mounts gives K code intelligence, used READ-ONLY: read-only is a usage convention (chief precedent) — the allowlist bars every coding BUILT-IN, but the server-level mcp__gitnexus grant admits gitnexus's own write-capable tools (rename, group_sync), which the charter forbids. The synthesizer rewrites `__KSTORE__` / `__LOGISTICS__` + the env placeholders at run time. The reused Google Calendar/Gmail/Drive connectors remain deferred. allowDiscoveredServers=false (D-070): the secretary tier never admits host-discovered MCP servers.
